text: Seeking endorsement of various events for liquor licensing purposes.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council advise the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario that it has no objection, for liquor licensing purposes, to the following requests noting that the applicants are required to comply with other applicable by-laws and to obtain the necessary permits for any patio areas extending into the City's right of way: a. a temporary liquor licence extension for the outdoor Walking Ring area at Woodbine Race Track, 555 Rexdale Boulevard, for the Queen's Plate Festival on June 29, 30 and July 1, 2018, from 11:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.; b. a temporary liquor licence extension for the following establishments taking part in the Lakeshore Village Business Improvement Area's 2018 Grilled Cheese Challenge, to be held on Lake Shore Boulevard West from Third Street to Seventh Street on June 9, 2018, from 11:00 a.m. to 6:00…
